_about: Rules of tests/form_filler.py (P1-a spec 3.2, 3.5): which generator fills which kind of hint of a handoff form. First matching rule wins. `when`: max_len (the reader's spec holds a length limit), kind:choice / kind:boolean (the reader's spec reads the hint as a closed list); `pattern`: a full match against the text inside the angle brackets. `context_tokens`: a token a path of the contract names, read from the FillContext key; `form_field_tokens`: a token read from the value the SAME form gives the named field (no such field in the form: the value is unfillable, naming the token); `literal_text`: a value with an angle bracket that is text, not a hint. A hint no rule fits is never guessed: the filler reports it as unfillable. The generators are named in form_filler.GENERATORS.
